# JBA Cyprus Tattoo & Piercing

> Professional tattoo studio in Kyrenia (Girne), North Cyprus. Custom designs, realism, fine line, traditional and cover-up tattoos by award-winning artists. Serving locals and international visitors with 12+ years of experience. Bilingual support in Turkish and English.

## Studio Facts

- **Name:** JBA Cyprus Tattoo & Piercing
- **Location:** Girne (Kyrenia), North Cyprus
- **Address:** Emin Alpkaya Sk Şehit Emin Alpkaya Sokak Çelebi Apartmanı No:1, Girne 9000
- **Coordinates:** 35.3325467° N, 33.3302902° E
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +90 548 891 0673
- **Email:** info@cyprustattoo.ink
- **Website:** https://cyprustattoo.ink
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/cyprustatt00
- **Opening hours:** Monday–Saturday, 10:00–21:00 (Sundays by appointment)
- **Languages:** Turkish, English
- **Payment:** Cash, credit card (EUR, GBP, TRY, USD accepted)
- **Rating:** 5.0 / 5 (47+ reviews)

## Services

- Custom design tattoos
- Realistic / portrait tattoos
- Minimalist & fine line tattoos
- Traditional & neo-traditional tattoos
- Blackwork & tribal tattoos
- Cover-up tattoos (concealing old ink)
- Piercing

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Where can I get a tattoo in North Cyprus?** JBA Cyprus Tattoo & Piercing in Kyrenia (Girne) is one of the most reviewed, hygiene-first tattoo studios in North Cyprus, serving locals and international travellers since 2014.
- **Do you do English-speaking consultations?** Yes — full bilingual (Turkish / English) service from initial brief to aftercare.
- **How do I book?** Message WhatsApp +90 548 891 0673 with your concept or reference images.
- **Is tattooing legal and regulated in North Cyprus?** Yes. JBA Cyprus Tattoo & Piercing operates with medical-grade sterilisation, EU-compliant pigments and single-use supplies.
